data.overview: Marionnaud is a France-based beauty retailer (Marionnaud Parfumeries SAS) owned by AS Watson. The only substantive brand-specific evaluation in the fetched sources is Good On You's rating, which scores Marionnaud "Not Good Enough" overall — weak on environmental policy, labour conditions, and especially animal welfare, where it holds no policy against animal testing. The brand's own fetched pages contain navigation/product listings rather than explicit self-claims.

papers.title: Marionnaud Sustainability Rating
papers.summary: Good On You rates Marionnaud 'Not Good Enough' overall (Planet 2/5, People 2/5, Animals 1/5). It found no evidence of lower-impact ingredients or that its emissions target is on track, and no biodegradability policy. On labour, part of production is BSCI-certified but there is no evidence of living wages or responsible mica sourcing. On animals, it has no policy against animal testing and no commitment to eliminate animal-derived ingredients.

findings.text: Marionnaud has a science-based emissions target but no evidence it is on track, and no policy on ingredient biodegradability or environmental toxicity.
findings.quote: It's set a science-based target to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in both its direct operations and supply chain but there's no evidence it is on track.

findings.text: There is no evidence Marionnaud ensures living wages or provides financial security to suppliers.
findings.quote: There's no evidence it ensures workers are paid living wages in its supply chain.

findings.text: Marionnaud uses mica but has disclosed no responsible-sourcing information to mitigate human rights risks.
findings.quote: It uses mica, but it hasn't disclosed any information regarding responsible sourcing that mitigates human rights risks.

findings.text: Marionnaud has no certification, policy, or statement against animal testing in its supply chains.
findings.quote: It does not have a certification, policy, or statement against the use of animal testing in its supply chains.

findings.text: Marionnaud has made no public commitment to eliminate animal-derived ingredients and does not state which it uses.
findings.quote: It doesn't clearly state what animal-derived ingredients it uses. It has not made any public commitments to eliminate animal-derived ingredients.
